title: The open-closed short exact sequence of an etale sheaf
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be the inclusion of the complementary open subscheme $U=X\setminus i(Z)$. For an abelian sheaf $F$ on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], let $j^{-1}F$ and $i^{-1}F$ be the inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], $j_!$ the extension by zero along $j$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and $i_*$ the direct image along $i$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $\varepsilon:j_!j^{-1}F\to F$ be the counit of the adjunction $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$ and $\eta:F\to i_*i^{-1}F$ the unit of the adjunction $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$. Then the sequence
$$
0\longrightarrow j_!j^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\ \varepsilon\ }F\xrightarrow{\ \eta\ }i_*i^{-1}F\longrightarrow0
$$
is exact in $\Ab(X_{\Et})$. The same holds for sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules for any ring $\Lambda$ (in particular $\Lambda=\mathbf F_r$), with the same maps.
